mcu_g_0160_2000002c.name: motor_main_ctx_ptr
mcu_g_0160_2000002c.description: Global pointer to the main motor-control context object (a struct whose layout is not in this packet). The code reads words +0x04, +0x64 and +0x70 through it (mcu_get_global_ctx_field_0x64 reads +0x64) and passes it as the first argument to the position, speed and fault helpers. No writer in this packet, so it is set elsewhere (probably once at startup).

mcu_g_0160_2000009c.name: motor_speed_tick_count
mcu_g_0160_2000009c.description: Byte counter incremented by mcu_speed_estimate_update and reset to 0 in the same call, so it probably counts ticks since the last speed estimate. Wraps at 255. Not read outside that function in this packet.

mcu_g_0160_200000a0.name: motor_position_sample_pair
mcu_g_0160_200000a0.description: Two signed 32-bit half-scale position words. Index 0 (0x200000A0) is written by mcu_speed_estimate_update from the return value of FUN_08001824 and read there through FUN_080013E4 (probably the previous accepted position). Index 1 (0x200000A4) is written by mcu_position_outlier_reject as half of a difference (probably the jump size). The function rejects a new sample when the jump is larger than 0x15E0000.

mcu_g_12b_200000b1.name: motor_sensor_filter_first_flag
mcu_g_12b_200000b1.description: 12b-only flag tested for zero and then cleared by mcu_sensor_filter_tick_v12b. It probably marks the first tick, so the seven sensor low-pass stages can be seeded once. No other access in this packet.

mcu_g_0160_200000b4.name: motor_limit_source_sel
mcu_g_0160_200000b4.description: Limit source selector. mcu_0160_08004E78 copies the byte at 0x20000B7F into it when it equals 5 and that byte is not 5, so 5 probably means 'use the default source'. Its address is also taken by mcu_limit_668_or_default.

mcu_g_0160_200000b5.name: motor_limit_default_loaded
mcu_g_0160_200000b5.description: Latch for the default-limit enable. mcu_limit_668_or_default copies the byte at 0x20000A9A into this byte when it is zero, so it probably records that the enable was loaded once.

mcu_g_0160_200000c0.name: motor_limiter_obj_word0
mcu_g_0160_200000c0.description: First word of the limiter object at 0x200000C0. Its address is passed to FUN_08007BD4 by mcu_0160_08003C38 and to mcu_limiter_set_range, so the object is larger than this word (its other fields are not in this packet). mcu_0160_08003C78 compares it with 0x20000A50 and copies it to 0x200003A4 and 0x200000F0. Probably a Q15 limit.

mcu_g_0160_200000f6.name: motor_limiter_range_flag
mcu_g_0160_200000f6.description: Flag written from param_3 by mcu_limiter_set_range. mcu_0160_08003C78 tests it for zero before using the limiter output (probably 'range set, use it'). Probably a boolean.

mcu_g_0160_200000fc.name: motor_derate_ref_value
mcu_g_0160_200000fc.description: Value written by mcu_target_derate_calc from the return value of FUN_08001824 (name not documented here). Its use is not visible in this packet (probably a saved reference used by the derate step).

mcu_g_0160_20000109.name: motor_limit_c_hold_count
mcu_g_0160_20000109.description: Counter for limit channel C. mcu_limit_chan_update_c increments it up to 5 and mcu_0160_08005480 resets it to 0. Together with motor_limit_c_state it decides whether the channel-C limit holds (probably a debounce count).

mcu_g_0160_2000010a.name: motor_ramp_moving_flag
mcu_g_0160_2000010a.description: Boolean set by mcu_ramp_asym_track to 1 when the ramp target at 0x20000168 differs from the ramp value at 0x20000164 (probably 'ramp still moving').

mcu_g_0160_2000010b.name: motor_fb_lpf_drive_latch
mcu_g_0160_2000010b.description: Latched copy of the drive-active flag 0x20000E33, made by mcu_fb_lpf_select_update. It is tested non-zero before the feedback filter branch is chosen (probably the filter is held while the drive is off or changing state).

mcu_g_0160_20000112.name: motor_limit_c_hold_ticks
mcu_g_0160_20000112.description: Down-counter for limit channel C. mcu_limit_chan_update_c decrements it while it is non-zero and compares it with 1000 in the same function (probably a time-out in control ticks).

mcu_g_0160_20000114.name: motor_limit_c_state
mcu_g_0160_20000114.description: State byte of limit channel C, tested for 0, 1 and at least 2 by mcu_limit_chan_update_c and reset to 0 there. The exact state names are not visible in this packet (probably 0 idle, 1 armed, 2 or more holding).

mcu_g_0160_20000118.name: motor_fb_lpf_io_pair
mcu_g_0160_20000118.description: Input and output words of the feedback low-pass. FUN_0800721A(&0x118, &0x11C, coeff) computes a Q30 one-pole filter: output = coeff * input + (1 - coeff) * output, with coeff taken from 0x20000144. Index 0 (0x118) is the input, set from FUN_08004AF0(0). Index 1 (0x11C) is the filtered output, also fed to FUN_0800A644 with the 0xB90 object.

mcu_g_0160_20000144.name: motor_fb_lpf_coeff
mcu_g_0160_20000144.description: Q30 filter coefficient of the feedback low-pass, selected in mcu_fb_lpf_select_update as 0x05832840, 0x00664D0A or 0x40000000 (1.0 in Q30). Probably one alpha per drive state.

mcu_g_0160_20000148.name: motor_edge_count_pair
mcu_g_0160_20000148.description: Edge counter stored as two 32-bit words, index 0 the low word (0x148) and index 1 the high word (0x14C), so probably a 64-bit counter. mcu_edge_pos_track tests the pair for non-zero and clears both, and tests the low word modulo 200 to add 0x18000 to the position once per 200 edges (probably one electrical revolution).

mcu_g_0160_20000164.name: motor_ramp_state4
mcu_g_0160_20000164.description: Four signed 32-bit ramp words used by mcu_ramp_asym_track, mcu_edge_pos_track, mcu_drive_state_update and mcu_0160_08003F2C. Index 0 (0x164) is the ramp value (probably the Q15 position). Index 1 (0x168) is the ramp target, retargeted in mcu_edge_pos_track and slewed toward index 0 by FUN_08002982 with step 0x1EB. Index 2 (0x16C) is set from FUN_08004AC4 in mcu_drive_state_update (probably a limit). Index 3 (0x170) is set from FUN_0800CE3C (probably a clamped position) and read by the ramp.

mcu_g_0160_20000174.name: motor_cmd_setpoint_q14
mcu_g_0160_20000174.description: Command word computed by mcu_drive_state_update as (DAT_20001FD8 >> 8) << 14 (probably the VCU command byte scaled to Q14). mcu_cmd_ramp_update accepts it as the new command when it differs from the previous command at 0x200001FC by less than 0xCCD and then copies it there (probably a rate limit).

mcu_g_0160_200001f8.name: motor_cmd_slew_pair
mcu_g_0160_200001f8.description: Two words of the command ramp, both used only by mcu_cmd_ramp_update. Index 0 (0x1F8) is the slew output, cleared to 0 and slewed toward a target with step 0xCCC by FUN_08002982. Index 1 (0x1FC) is the previous command: set from 0x20000174 and cleared in some cases. It is also compared with 0x20000684 as an upper bound.

mcu_g_0160_20000204.name: motor_cmd_q15_scaled
mcu_g_0160_20000204.description: Scaled command word computed by mcu_cmd_ramp_update as (uVar2 << 15), where uVar2 is the command derived from the VCU frame (probably the command in Q15 units).

mcu_g_0160_20000214.name: motor_cmd_ramp_out
mcu_g_0160_20000214.description: Ramped command output. mcu_cmd_ramp_update slews it toward iVar1 with step 0xCCC (FUN_08002982) and also assigns it directly. mcu_0160_08003D2C copies it to the caller's block and multiplies it by iVar3 to form a 64-bit product (probably the controller command).

mcu_g_143_20000224.name: motor_limit_chan_a_w0
mcu_g_143_20000224.description: Word 0 of the configuration block of limit channel A in the 143 build. mcu_limit_chan_cfg_a copies it to offset 0 of the destination struct.

mcu_g_0160_20000230.name: motor_limit_chan_c_w0
mcu_g_0160_20000230.description: Word 0 of the configuration of limit channel C in the 152 and 0160 builds. mcu_init_q14_copies_from_200003de sets it to the byte at 0x200003DE shifted left by 14 (Q14), and mcu_limit_chan_update_c copies it to offset 0 of the destination.

mcu_g_143_20000230.name: motor_limit_chan_a_w1_w5
mcu_g_143_20000230.description: Three words of channel A's configuration in the 143 build. Index 0 (0x230) goes to destination offset +4, index 1 (0x234) to +0x10 and index 2 (0x238) to +0x14. mcu_limit_chan_cfg_a copies them.

mcu_g_143_2000023d.name: motor_limit_chan_a_byte10
mcu_g_143_2000023d.description: Byte of channel A's configuration (143 build), copied by mcu_limit_chan_cfg_a to destination offset +0x0A. Probably a mode or flag.

mcu_g_0160_2000023c.name: motor_limit_chan_c_w1_w5
mcu_g_0160_2000023c.description: Three words of channel C's configuration (152 and 0160 builds). Index 0 (0x23C) goes to destination offset +4, index 1 (0x240) to +0x10 and index 2 (0x244) to +0x14. mcu_limit_chan_update_c copies them, and mcu_init_q14_copies_from_200003de writes index 0.

mcu_g_143_20000240.name: motor_limit_chan_b_w0
mcu_g_143_20000240.description: Word 0 of the configuration of limit channel B in the 143 build. mcu_limit_chan_cfg_b copies it to offset 0 of the destination.

mcu_g_143_2000024c.name: motor_limit_chan_b_w1_w5
mcu_g_143_2000024c.description: Three words of channel B's configuration (143 build). Index 0 (0x24C) goes to destination offset +4, index 1 (0x250) to +0x10 and index 2 (0x254) to +0x14. mcu_limit_chan_cfg_b copies them.

mcu_g_0160_2000024c.name: motor_limit_chan_d_w0
mcu_g_0160_2000024c.description: Word 0 of the configuration of limit channel D (152 and 0160 builds). mcu_init_q14_copies_from_200003de sets it to the byte at 0x200003DE shifted left by 14 (Q14), and mcu_limit_chan_cfg_d copies it to offset 0 of the destination.

mcu_g_143_20000259.name: motor_limit_chan_b_byte10
mcu_g_143_20000259.description: Byte of channel B's configuration (143 build), copied by mcu_limit_chan_cfg_b to destination offset +0x0A. Probably a mode or flag.

mcu_g_0160_20000249.name: motor_limit_chan_c_byte10
mcu_g_0160_20000249.description: Byte of channel C's configuration (152 and 0160 builds), copied by mcu_limit_chan_update_c to destination offset +0x0A. Probably a mode or flag.

mcu_g_0160_20000258.name: motor_limit_chan_d_w1_w5
mcu_g_0160_20000258.description: Three words of channel D's configuration (152 and 0160 builds). Index 0 (0x258) goes to destination offset +4, index 1 (0x25C) to +0x10 and index 2 (0x260) to +0x14. mcu_limit_chan_cfg_d copies them, and mcu_init_q14_copies_from_200003de writes index 0.

mcu_g_0160_20000265.name: motor_limit_chan_d_byte10
mcu_g_0160_20000265.description: Byte of channel D's configuration (152 and 0160 builds), copied by mcu_limit_chan_cfg_d to destination offset +0x0A. Probably a mode or flag.

mcu_g_0160_20000268.name: motor_limit_ptr_table
mcu_g_0160_20000268.description: Table of four pointers, each to a limit block whose first word is the limit value (probably). Indexed by the limit mode byte at 0x2000065A and, with 0xFF meaning none, by the byte at 0x20000B54. Used by mcu_0160_08004E78 through FUN_080057E8 and by mcu_limit_target_b3c_update.

mcu_g_0160_2000027e.name: motor_scale_prev_u16
mcu_g_0160_2000027e.description: Previous sample of the 16-bit value at 0x20000F5A. mcu_0160_08002228 copies F5A here and mcu_scale_delta_q15 subtracts it from F5A to get the step, scaled by 0xDBF in Q15 (probably a rate or position delta).

mcu_g_0160_20000280.name: motor_speed_max_ring_idx
mcu_g_0160_20000280.description: Write index (0 to 19, wraps at 20) into the 20-entry ring at 0x20000F64 that mcu_speed_from_max_u12 fills.

mcu_g_0160_20000282.name: motor_speed_period_ring_idx
mcu_g_0160_20000282.description: Write index (0 to 19, wraps at 20) into the 20-entry ring at 0x20000294 that mcu_speed_from_period_min fills.

mcu_g_0160_20000284.name: motor_speed_max_out_pair
mcu_g_0160_20000284.description: Two words of mcu_speed_from_max_u12. Index 0 (0x284) is the result (max sample - 30) * 0x8000, in Q15 speed units (probably), which the function returns. Index 1 (0x288) is a wrap counter from 0 to 19 for the sample ring.

mcu_g_0160_2000028c.name: motor_speed_period_out_pair
mcu_g_0160_2000028c.description: Two words of mcu_speed_from_period_min. Index 0 (0x28C) is the result (minimum period - 30) * 0x8000, in Q15 speed units (probably), which the function returns. Index 1 (0x290) is a wrap counter from 0 to 19 for the period ring at 0x20000294.

mcu_g_0160_20000294.name: motor_speed_period_ring
mcu_g_0160_20000294.description: Ring of 20 captured periods (32-bit), filled from DAT_20000F58 by mcu_speed_from_period_min. The minimum is found by FUN_08002964 over all 20 entries and turned into a speed estimate (probably the fastest period gives the speed).

mcu_g_0160_20000348.name: motor_pi_gain_latch_pair
mcu_g_0160_20000348.description: Two latch bytes of mcu_pi_update_gain_sched. Index 0 (0x348) and index 1 (0x349) are each set to 1 or cleared to 0 by the speed-scheduled PI step. They probably record which gain region is active (Kp doubled, Ki halved below 0xF0001).
